title: Build + packaging

title: Close terminal window when claude session exits
description:

Expected behavior: Terminal window should close automatically when the claude session exits.

Implementation: Listen for PTY exit event and close the associated terminal window.
close_reason: Spawn claude directly instead of via bash shell. Window now closes when claude exits.

title: iTerm2 integration (AppleScript)

Requires: detecting system claude binary, native module rebuild for node-pty, terminal UI components.
